scenario: Sub-tick durations warn, don't error per LTAC.9.3 — `after 500_ms: log info "ok"` compiles OK; sub-tick durations may produce a warning but are not a hard error.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "triggered"
    after 500_ms:
        log info "sub-tick"
